title: Maou-sama no Kinyoubi
titleNative: 魔王さまの金曜日
synonyms: The Demon Lord's Day Off: Friday
synopsis: The Demon Lord, who was once defeated in battle by a hero, was suddenly transported from the demon world to modern-day Japan due to a runaway spell she cast at the end of the battle. Having efficiently recovered most of the magical power she had lost in the previous battle by consuming modern food, the Demon Lord returns to the Demon World once again. Despite reigning over the demon world as the Demon Lord, she frequently makes secret visits to Japan, spending her days eating easily obtainable convenience store food. One day, by chance, she came across a back alley in a busy downtown area and ended up helping a girl who was being harassed by several men. As a reward for helping her, she was taken to a cozy oden restaurant... The serious and rigid "Demon Lord" discovers truly delicious food and drinks, and friends to share them with after work. (Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

title: The Voiceless Sacrifice of the Black Dragon
titleRomaji: Koe Naki Niehime to Kokuryuu no Kekkon
titleEnglish: The Voiceless Sacrifice of the Black Dragon
titleNative: 声なき贄姫と黒龍の結婚
synonyms: The Silent Sacrifice Princess And The Black Dragon's Marriage
The Voiceless Sacrifice of the Black Dragon
synopsis: The Kozuki family was granted the Black Dragon's blessing, allowing them to heal the sick and purify impurity with their voices alone. But Ayame's life shatters after her parents' death, leaving her at the mercy of her cruel aunt and uncle, who tortured her until she lost her voice. As their daughter, Mari, rises to become the new priestess, Ayame is offered as a sacrifice to the Black Dragon. "Why do I have to die like this? Please help me!" In response to her desperate plea, the Black Dragon appears as a striking man and takes her hand, whisking her away to his realm. Chosen to be the bride of the Black Dragon Saku, Ayame finds herself in the enchanting Black Dragon Manor, suspended between the heavens and the human world. But jealousy ignites in Mari, who vows to reclaim Saku and make Ayame suffer once more. (Source: Pocket Comics)

title: 7th
titleNative: セブンス
synopsis: In a world of swords and magic, where the Goddess is revered, Lyell Walt was fortunate enough to be born the first son and heir to an earldom. That is, until his parents disown him for losing pitifully in a fight with his younger sister, Ceres. Lyell had once been hailed as a prodigy—a wonder child—but the birth of his sister changed everything. After Ceres wounds him in their duel, an enigmatic old man swoops in to rescue Lyell and bestows upon him a necklace containing a jewel that has been blessed by the goddesses and passed down through the last seven generations of Walt leaders. As Lyell sets out, necklace in hand, will he be able to prove himself despite his humiliating loss to his sister? And moreover, will he be able to solve the mystery behind Ceres’s monstrous strength and the strange sway she seems to hold over his entire family? (Source: J-Novel Club)

titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)
